items.title: The stalk of the pushforward along a finite morphism is the product of the stalks over the geometric lifts
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the stalk of the pushforward of a sheaf along a finite morphism at a geometric point as the product of the stalks over the finitely many lifts of that point (statement lines 517-528, tag 0DK3). The proof passes to an etale neighbourhood of the geometric point, uses the base change description of pushforwards to reduce to a finite morphism of schemes, and applies the known scheme statement there. The reduction through the etale neighbourhood is the substance, so the claim is H2.
